title: 第3章  真，真恢复了
content_zh:
“苏烬生来了，苏烬生终于是赶回来了！”
“赶回来又怎么样，不过是多一个人受辱罢了，还不如不回来呢！”
“是啊，这于彦君乃是练气三重境武者，打他们两个人就是易如反掌！”
“接下来可有好戏看了，我们可不能走！”
诸多杂役弟子见到苏烬生飞速赶来的身影后，脸上笑容更盛，纷纷开口议论出声。
“烬生，快走！”
“于彦君在这里，快走！”
林月舒听闻周围的议论之声后，瞬间回神，随即便立刻喊到出声！
“废话真多！”
于彦君脸上露出一副不耐烦的神色，抓着头发的手猛然一推，让林月舒再次倒在地上。
“来得正好，今日我刚好手痒，一定要好好解解痒才行！”
说罢，便开始摩拳擦掌，准备出手！
“于彦君！老子弄死你！”
苏烬生的声音宛若野兽般低沉，飞驰的身影未曾停滞半分，穿过杂役弟子人群，直奔于彦君！
“咻！”
拳风猎猎，凶猛至极！
凡阶中级武技，虎啸拳直接施展而出！
“砰！！”
于彦君猝不及防，直接被这一拳击中，整个人直接倒飞出去。
直至数丈之后，才重重地砸在地上，这一拳直接让他胸口塌陷，骨头断裂，鲜血不断从口中涌出。

他根本没有想到，苏烬生竟然敢动手，要知道，以前也就是替林月舒受辱罢了。
今日，怎么会如此反常？
苏烬生强行压制心中怒意，走到林月舒的面前，将其搀扶了起来。
然而，当看到那散乱头发以及脸上巴掌红印时，心中怒火更盛！
转头便又朝着地面上的于彦君冲了过去！
“草尼玛的！”
此刻的于彦君稍微动弹一下，疼痛便会席卷全身，已然没了反抗之力。
“我说过，谁若敢动月舒半根手指，便让谁生不如死！”
苏烬生居高临下的望着动弹不得的于彦君，声音宛若来自人间地狱一般，阴冷逼人。
说话间，便抬起小腿猛然朝着其胯下踢去！
“啊！！！”
撕心裂肺般的痛苦声响起，于彦君双手捂着胯下，身形弓若虾米一般，蜷缩成一团。
脸上青筋暴露，面色涨红，双目瞪得溜圆，嘴唇疯狂颤抖，一层细汗瞬间渗透而出。
苏烬生望着于彦君那副痛苦的模样，心中没有半点怜悯之心，而是一步迈上前去。
踩在了其小腿上，随即开始用力！
“咔嚓！”
小腿骨头断裂！
“咔嚓！”
大腿骨头断裂！
“咔嚓！”

“咔嚓……”
骨头断裂的声音接连响起，不过片刻时间，苏烬生便已将其四肢骨头逐个踩碎！
不远处，诸多围观的杂役弟子终于是回过神来，吃惊地望着眼前一幕。
“不，不是吧，于彦君竟然被其一拳打得毫无反抗之力！”
“苏，苏烬生突破至炼气二重境了，他好像恢复了！”
“真，真恢复了，这些年来欺辱他的人，恐怕要完蛋了！”
“没错，纵观全宗门，谁曾经不仰望苏烬生的英姿？”
下一刻，诸多杂役目光下移，落到了那于彦君身上，顿时间，均是眉头紧皱。
四肢骨骼尽断，利用药物躺几个月还能恢复，但胯下之物被废了，可就无法恢复了！
心中顿感苏烬生出手狠辣，毫不留情！
同时，也庆幸自己当初没有落井下石，屈辱嘲讽！
否则的话，可能会落得于彦君一样的下场！
一侧，林月舒也被眼前的一幕所震惊，望着那道替自己出气的身影，略微有些着迷。
曾几时，苏烬生也是这般威武霸气，英姿迷人！
如今，那个天才妖孽，似乎回来了！
一时间，心中不由得激动万分，一年了，苏烬生终于恢复了！
她比任何人都清楚，苏烬生这一年来受了多少苦累，尤其是那种身份的落差感，根本不是常人所能够忍受的。
“啊！！！”
最后一道惨痛声响起，于彦君似乎失去了所有力气，瘫软在地面上。
失去魂魄一般，怔怔地望着虚空。

他没有想到，苏烬生有朝一日竟然还能够突破境界！
更没有想到，自己会沦落至这般下场！
苏烬生望着那道行尸走肉般的身影，眼神冷漠，弹指间，一抹灵气便朝着其丹田冲去。
顿时间，灵气散尽，丹田破碎！
随即，又将院落中的斧头握在手中，将其四肢砍了下来。
“你放心，我不会杀你的！”
“我说过，要让你生不如死！”
声音阴戾，令人心中颤栗。
一些围观的杂役弟子见到这一幕之后，双腿有些发软，再也无法忍受，纷纷转身离开。
林月舒见到这一幕之后，神情冷漠，并无半点同情。
毕竟，这于彦君先前欺辱她们数次，更是联合张霖将苏烬生的腿打断。
如今就算是将其斩杀当场，也绝不过分。
只是，她第一次见到这般血腥的场面，顿感体内一阵翻涌，有种想吐的感觉。
随即，便撇过头去，不再去看。
而苏烬生则是在其身上摸索了一番，将凝气丹和下品灵石都取了出来。
随即便将于彦君连带着断掉的四肢一同丢了出去。
如今于彦君丹田破碎，四肢尽断，生活不能自理，活着比死了还难受。
并且，绝无可能恢复。
因为修复丹田的灵药极其珍贵，有价无市，没有人会将这般珍贵的东西用在废物身上。
诸多杂役弟子见状也纷纷识趣地离开，并且还贴心地把院门关上。

“烬生哥哥，你的丹田恢复了？”
林月舒擦去嘴角的血迹，美目之中绽放精光，言语中满是欣喜。
“嗯，已经恢复了！”
苏烬生点了点头，看着那头发散乱，脸上红印未消的身影，顿感一阵心痛！
迈步走上前去，轻轻地将其拥入怀中，轻声道。
“你放心，从今以后，我不会让任何人欺负到我们头上！”
林月舒面色红润几分，低下头，不敢去看苏烬生，嘴角处，翘起一抹羞色笑意，全然忘记脸上的疼痛！
“对了，烬生哥哥，这是我领取的凝气丹和十枚下品灵石，你快拿去修炼吧！”
说话间，林月舒脱离怀抱，背过身子，从怀中拿出一个小瓷瓶子，又将腰间的袋子解开，递了过去。
“不用，这些你还是留着修炼吧，我自己领取的还没有吞噬呢！”
苏烬生的脸上露出一抹笑意，推辞出声。
“你快拿着！”
“反正我留着也是浪费！”
林月舒说话间，便将这两样东西塞到了苏烬生的手中，继而开口。
“我这辈子是没啥希望了，以后可就仰仗你保护我了！”
苏烬生望着手中的凝气丹和下品灵石，一时间竟不知说些什么。
当初二人刚加入宗门之时，林月舒便是炼气一重境，至今六年时间，未曾突破过，始终原地踏步。
他为内门弟子第一人时，带着林月舒找过宗主查看，却不知是何等原因。
这也让林月舒逐渐接受了现实。
“你应该是特殊体质，肯定不会一直这样的！”

苏烬生心中暗下决心，等到以后实力强大了，一定要帮助林月舒找到不能突破的原因！
“嗯！”
林月舒点了点头，脸上挤出一个勉强的笑容，随后似乎想到了什么，连忙出声道。
“你现在丹田恢复了，赶快去吞噬凝气丹和下品灵石提升境界吧！”
“莫要再耽误时间了！”
闻言，苏烬生点了点头，如今丹田恢复，他需要时间和足够的修炼资源来提升境界。
刚准备离去，却又猛地停下脚步，目光看向地面上的血迹。
还未来得及开口，林月舒便出声道。
“这些血迹我来清理就行了，你快去修炼吧！”
苏烬生闻言，脸上露出一抹笑意，不再言语，转身便走出了院门。
走出院门的瞬间，脸上笑容消失。
他知道，林月舒如此催促他修炼的原因是，他的境界实力还不足以自保。
因为欺辱他们的人还有很多，实力也有比于彦君强的，比如于彦君的好兄弟胡荣！
胡荣乃是杂役总管的儿子，依靠此身份在诸多杂役弟子中横行霸道，持强临弱，没少欺辱他。
若是不尽快提升境界实力，等胡荣找上门来，将会有很大麻烦！
content_en:
"Su Jinsheng is here, Su Jinsheng is finally back!"
"So what if you come back? It's just one more person being humiliated. It's better not to come back!"
"Yes, this Yu Yanjun is a warrior at the third level of Qi training. It's easy to beat the two of them!"
"There's going to be a great show next, we can't leave!"
When many handyman disciples saw Su Jinsheng arriving quickly, the smiles on their faces became even brighter, and they all started talking.
"Jinsheng, leave quickly!"
"Yu Yanjun is here, hurry up!"
After Lin Yueshu heard the comments around him, he came to his senses instantly, and then immediately shouted out!
"So much nonsense!"
Yu Yanjun had an impatient look on his face, and the hand holding his hair suddenly pushed, causing Lin Yueshu to fall to the ground again.
"I came just in time. My hands are itchy today. I must relieve the itch!"
After saying that, he started gearing up and getting ready to take action!
"Yu Yanjun! I will kill you!"
Su Jinsheng's voice was as low as a wild beast, and his speeding figure never stopped for a moment, passing through the crowd of servant disciples and heading straight for Yu Yanjun!
"Phew!"
Fist hunting is extremely ferocious!
The ordinary intermediate martial arts skill, Tiger Roaring Fist is used directly!
"Bang!!"
Yu Yanjun was caught off guard and was hit by the punch, sending him flying backwards.
It wasn't until several feet later that he hit the ground heavily. This punch directly caused his chest to collapse, his bones to break, and blood to pour out of his mouth.
He never thought that Su Jinsheng would dare to take action. You know, he was just humiliated for Lin Yueshu before.
Why is it so abnormal today?
Su Jinsheng suppressed the anger in his heart, walked to Lin Yueshu, and helped him up.
However, when I saw the messy hair and the red mark from the slap on my face, I became even more angry!
He turned around and rushed towards Yu Yanjun on the ground!
"Cao Nima's!"
At this moment, if Yu Yanjun moved even a little, pain would sweep through his body, and he would no longer have the strength to resist.
"I said, if anyone dares to touch half of Yueshu's finger, his life will be worse than death!"
Su Jinsheng looked down at Yu Yanjun, who was unable to move, and his voice sounded as cold as if it came from hell on earth.
As he spoke, he raised his calf and kicked it suddenly towards his crotch!
"Ah!!!"
The sound of heartbreaking pain sounded, and Yu Yanjun covered his crotch with his hands, curled up into a ball with his body as bowed as a shrimp.
The veins on his face were exposed, his face turned red, his eyes were wide open, his lips were trembling crazily, and a layer of sweat seeped out instantly.
Su Jinsheng looked at Yu Yanjun's painful look without any pity in his heart, but stepped forward.
He stepped on his calf and started to exert force!
"Crack!"
Broken calf bone!
"Crack!"
Broken thigh bone!
"Crack!"
"Click..."
The sounds of broken bones were heard one after another, but within a moment, Su Jinsheng had trampled the bones of his limbs one by one!
Not far away, many handyman disciples who were watching finally came to their senses and looked at the scene in front of them in surprise.
"No, that's not it. Yu Yanjun was punched so hard that he had no power to resist!"
"Su, Su Jinsheng has broken through to the second level of Qi Refining. He seems to have recovered!"
"Really, really recovered. The people who bullied him all these years are probably going to be finished!"
"That's right, looking at the whole sect, who has not looked up to Su Jinsheng's heroic appearance?"
The next moment, many of the handymen's eyes moved down and fell on Yu Yanjun. For a moment, they all frowned.
The bones in the limbs are completely broken, and they can recover by lying down for a few months with medicine, but the thing under the crotch is destroyed, and there is no way to recover!
I suddenly felt in my heart that Su Jinsheng was ruthless and showed no mercy!
At the same time, I am also glad that I did not add insult to injury and ridicule him!
Otherwise, you may end up like Yu Yanjun!
On one side, Lin Yueshu was also shocked by the scene in front of her., looking at the figure venting his anger, slightly fascinated.
There was a time when Su Jinsheng was so mighty, domineering, and charming!
Now, that genius monster seems to be back!
For a moment, I couldn't help but feel extremely excited. After a year, Su Jinsheng finally recovered!
She knew better than anyone how much Su Jinsheng had suffered this year, especially the sense of status gap, which was simply not something ordinary people could bear.
"Ah!!!"
The last tragic sound sounded, and Yu Yanjun seemed to have lost all his strength and collapsed on the ground.
As if he had lost his soul, he stared blankly into the void.
He did not expect that Su Jinsheng would be able to break through the realm one day!
I never thought that I would end up like this!
Su Jinsheng looked at the zombie-like figure with cold eyes, and with a snap of his fingers, a touch of spiritual energy rushed towards his dantian.
In a moment, the spiritual energy dissipated and the Dantian was shattered!
Then, he held the ax in the courtyard in his hand and chopped off his limbs.
"Don't worry, I won't kill you!"
"I said, I will make your life worse than death!"
The voice was sinister, making people tremble in their hearts.
After seeing this scene, some of the handyman disciples who were watching felt their legs become weak and could no longer bear it, so they turned and left.
After seeing this scene, Lin Yueshu looked cold and showed no sympathy.
After all, Yu Yanjun had bullied them several times before, and even teamed up with Zhang Lin to break Su Jinsheng's legs.
Now even if he was killed on the spot, it would not be too much.
However, this was the first time she saw such a bloody scene, and she felt a surge in her body, making her feel like vomiting.
Immediately, he turned his head and stopped looking.
Su Jinsheng, on the other hand, groped around on his body and took out the Qi Condensing Pill and low-grade spiritual stones.
Then Yu Yanjun was thrown out with his broken limbs.
Now Yu Yanjun's Dantian is shattered, his limbs are broken, he can't take care of himself, and life is more uncomfortable than death.
And there is absolutely no chance of recovery.
Because the elixir for repairing the Dantian is extremely precious and has a price but no market, no one would use such a precious thing on waste.
Upon seeing this, many handyman disciples left in a sensible manner, and even closed the courtyard door considerately.
"Brother Jinsheng, has your Dantian recovered?"
Lin Yueshu wiped the blood from the corner of her mouth, her beautiful eyes sparkled, and her words were full of joy.
"Well, it has recovered!"
Su Jinsheng nodded, looking at the figure with disheveled hair and lingering red marks on his face, he suddenly felt heartache!
Stepping forward, he gently held him in his arms and whispered.
"Don't worry, from now on, I won't let anyone bully us!"
Lin Yueshu's face turned a little rosy. She lowered her head, not daring to look at Su Jinsheng. A shy smile curled up at the corner of her mouth, completely forgetting the pain on her face!
"By the way, Brother Jinsheng, these are the Qi Condensation Pills and ten low-grade spiritual stones that I received. You can quickly take them to practice!"
While talking, Lin Yueshu broke away from the embrace, turned her back, took out a small porcelain bottle from her arms, untied the bag on her waist, and handed it over.
"No, you should keep these for practice. I haven't swallowed the ones I received yet!"
Su Jinsheng had a smile on his face and declined.
"Hurry up and take it!"
"It's a waste if I keep it anyway!"
As Lin Yueshu spoke, he put these two things into Su Jinsheng's hands and then spoke.
"I have no hope in this life. I will rely on you to protect me from now on!"
Su Jinsheng looked at the Qi Condensation Pill and low-grade spirit stone in his hand, and for a moment he didn't know what to say.
When the two first joined the sect, Lin Yueshu was at the first level of Qi refining. In the past six years, he has not made a breakthrough and has always stayed in the same place.
When he was the first inner disciple, he took Lin Yueshu to the sect master to check, but he didn't know the reason.
This also made Lin Yueshu gradually accept the reality."You must have a special physique, you won't always be like this!"
Su Jinsheng secretly made up his mind that when he becomes stronger in the future, he must help Lin Yueshu find the reason why he cannot break through!
"Yeah!"
Lin Yueshu nodded, forced a smile on his face, and then seemed to think of something, and said quickly.
"Now that your Dantian has recovered, hurry up and swallow the Qi Condensing Pills and low-grade spiritual stones to improve your realm!"
"Don't waste any more time!"
Hearing this, Su Jinsheng nodded. Now that his Dantian has recovered, he needs time and sufficient training resources to improve his level.
Just as he was about to leave, he suddenly stopped and looked at the blood on the ground.
Before he could speak, Lin Yueshu spoke out.
"I'll just clean up these blood stains. Go and practice!"
When Su Jinsheng heard this, a smile appeared on his face, he turned around and walked out of the courtyard without saying a word.
The moment he walked out of the door, the smile on his face disappeared.
He knew that the reason why Lin Yueshu urged him to practice so much was that his level of strength was not enough to protect himself.
Because there are many people who bully them, and some are stronger than Yu Yanjun, such as Yu Yanjun’s good brother Hu Rong!
Hu Rongnai was the son of the handyman in charge. Relying on this status, he became domineering among the many handyman disciples. He used the strong to defeat the weak and often bullied him.
If you don't improve your realm strength as soon as possible, you will be in big trouble when Hu Rong comes to your door!
